title: Astro Wing: Starfighter
tagline: A new space shooter for the Atari 7800
ready: Press Z to start. Click or press a key for sound.
about: The Evil Empire has scattered five Relics of Power across the cosmos. Fly the M-78 Starfighter through six sectors: destroy the enemy fighters, dodge the asteroids, and claim each sector's reward.
Every sector cleared upgrades the ship: twin blasters, a faster engine, a stronger hull, a quicker reactor and an extra life, for the flagship waiting in the sixth.
Asteroids cannot be destroyed, and inertia is real: thrust the other way to slow down.
